description: Editor viewport camera, rendering settings, and picking

camera.description: Current viewport camera position, rotation (as both quaternion and euler angles), and projection settings

render_settings.description: Current render pipeline settings (resolution, debug overlays, etc.)

visible_objects.description: List of object IDs currently visible in the viewport frustum

temporal_aa.description: TAA state: enabled and sharpness as requested by the editor; with a live renderer also active, msaa_requested, scene_sample_count and mip_bias

SetViewportCamera.description: Move the viewport fly camera. Position, rotation, and fov are tweened over duration_seconds; near/far planes are not affected.
SetViewportCamera.expects_result_note: Returns as soon as the tween starts when duration_seconds > 0. The move is never undoable — the viewport camera is editor-only state.

rotation.description: [x,y,z,w] quaternion or [x,y,z] euler angles in DEGREES; pitch is clamped to +/-89 to match the fly camera

duration_seconds.description: Tween duration in seconds. Defaults to 1.0 (animated); <= 0 = immediate. An immediate move discards TAA history.

SetTemporalAA.description: Enable or disable temporal anti-aliasing for the editor viewport. MSAA is turned off while TAA is on.
SetTemporalAA.expects_result_note: Applied by the renderer at the start of the next frame. Editor-only state; not undoable.

sharpness.description: Post-resolve sharpen strength, clamped to [0, 1]; 0 disables it. Left unchanged when omitted.
